title: Marketing Audit
plan:
Stream the body in via update_document with insert ops, one block at a time. Recommended structure:

1. replace the header block: set title to the company name and subtitle to their website URL.
2. insert a kpis block with 4 metrics: Est. Ad Spend, Reviews (avg + count), SEO Score, Domain Age.
3. insert a text block starting with "## Summary" — one paragraph verdict on the prospect.
4. insert a two_column block with the website screenshot (left) and website issue bullets under "### Website Issues" (right). Only insert this if you actually have a screenshot URL — otherwise insert a plain text block with the issues.
5. insert a text block starting with "## Advertising Presence" summarizing their paid channels and estimated spend.
6. insert a table block with headers ["Competitor", "Est. Monthly Spend", "Ad Channels", "Rank"] and real rows (3–5 competitors).
7. insert a callout variant="tip" title="Recommendation" with a clear pitch — what to sell them and why.
8. insert a footer block.

Gather data in parallel via research / exa / external tools before inserting. Never write literal "{{PLACEHOLDER}}" text. Skip any block you don't have real data for rather than inventing numbers.
